name: Beatriz Almeida
bio: Beatriz's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by her father's involvement in local karting events. She pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. After graduating, she joined a small Brazilian racing team, rapidly gaining experience in vehicle setup and data analysis. Her dedication and problem-solving skills caught the attention of Allied Racing, who headhunted her to bolster their engineering team. Beatriz is known for her meticulous approach, demanding high standards from her team while fostering a collaborative environment. She believes in continuous improvement, constantly seeking innovative solutions to enhance performance.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: A strong woman, Beatriz has an athletic build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Brazilian coffee in the garage every morning.
